name: Long-Term Care Cost Calculator
meta_title: Long-Term Care Cost Calculator: Future Cost and Gap
meta_description: Project the future cost of in-home care, adult day care, assisted living or a nursing home from local prices, and see how much savings and insurance cover.
subtitle: Project what long-term care could cost by the time you need it, using prices you enter for your area and an inflation rate. See how far your savings and any long-term care insurance would go and how much is left uncovered.
